digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows / CI gate guards
propositions: The predates-gate shell guard appears 24 times across six workflow files with inconsistent application, creating drift risk and undetected gaps.
A shared implementation (composite action, shell helper, or module) cannot replace inline guards because it would be absent on pre-gate trees, causing false skips or resolution failures.
Three of four gate readers already share a single `gate_enabled` function; the fourth `code_review_enabled` must retain its broad exception handling and silent-false semantics.
Two scripts (check_readme_quickstart.py, probe_rebar.py) are guarded in gerrit-verify.yaml but not in test.yml, exemplifying the drifting-copy defect.

A parity test asserting guard presence and empty-tree skip semantics for all 24 sites generalizes the existing mutation-selector pin to all gates, replacing unavailable consolidation with durable invariant enforcement.
